study type: Interrater reliability and agreement study (cross-sectional design)
exposure: 0-10 numeric rating scale for uterine tone
cohort: The study involved pairs of 62 unique obstetricians independently rating the uterine tone of patients undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: The 0 to 10 numeric rating scale for uterine tone demonstrated good to excellent interrater reliability and good interrater agreement among obstetricians.
mod_finding: The study specifically evaluated the uterine tone scale during cesarean delivery, demonstrating its reliability and agreement in this mode of birth.
followup_time: 10 minutes after cesarean delivery (measurements taken at 3 and 10 minutes postpartum)
